title: Read an rxode2 or nlmixr2 model function — pmx_read_rxode2
code: one_cmt <- function() {   ini({     tka <- 0.45     tcl <- 1     tv <- 3.45     eta.cl ~ 0.3     prop.sd <- 0.1   })   model({     ka <- exp(tka)     cl <- exp(tcl + eta.cl)     v <- exp(tv)     cp <- linCmt()     cp ~ prop(prop.sd)   }) } pmx_read_rxode2(one_cmt) #> <zupkpmx_model> read from rxode2 #> Structure: one-compartment closed form, first-order input (ADVAN2 TRANS2) #> Parameters: 4, initial values only #> Random effects: eta.cl on cl (exp) #> Endpoints: cp (proportional)
